source: REAL-PS4 / AISHELL-4 stitched meetings (real Mandarin meeting audio with real overlapping speech)
note: FunASR's cluster backend returns a single cluster whenever it sees fewer than 20 segments, so short clips cannot be used to judge diarization quality.

meeting_to_meeting_time.note: The same, with cluster ownership taken from the timeline.

cross_session_time.note: The same, with cluster ownership taken from the timeline.

registry_identification_time.note: The same measurement, with cluster ownership taken from the timeline instead of the ASR transcript.

timeline.note: Turns attributed by time against the documented utterances, not by the ASR transcript.
